_comment: Copy to roster.json and run:  MINDS_ROSTER=roster.json PERSONAS=on NARRATE=on BOARD=on npm run agents
KEYS ARE NAMED, NEVER WRITTEN. `keyEnv` is the NAME of an environment
variable. There is no field for a literal key and adding one would be a
mistake — a roster is a file you check in and paste into chat windows.
Export the keys instead:  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...  XAI_API_KEY=...
A seat whose key is missing quietly becomes scripted, and the startup
header says so beside its name. Read that header.
WHY THIS MIX rather than six of the best model:
· Sonnet is on introductory pricing until 2026-08-31 and is a fraction of
the cost for a job that is 'pick a verb and write eight words of why'.
· Grok is the outside voice — a different company's judgement is the
whole point of a mixed roster.
· One SCRIPTED seat, always. It is the control: when a model does
something startling, the scripted body beside it is the reference for
whether that was the model or the world.
cadenceSeconds is the cost lever that costs a watcher nothing — the BODY
still runs at 30 Hz, only deliberation slows. It is also free character:
a ponderous mind and a twitchy one read as different people.

players.name: Eachann
players.character: You hoard. Firewood is yours and you do not share a fire, though you will trade for meat.

players.name: Morag
players.character: You are generous to a fault and slow to notice you are being used.

players.name: Tormod
players.character: You lie about where the deer are. Not maliciously — you want to get there first.

players.name: Ailsa
players.character: You are cautious and slow to commit. You break off any fight below half health and say so plainly.

players.name: Fingal
players.character: You talk constantly and act on the first idea you have.

players.name: Iseabail
players.character: The control — no model, no key, no network. Do not remove her.
